name: DIAGNOSTIC fast
notes: NOT A SOLDERING PROFILE. Peaks at about 52 C so a whole cycle -- preheat, soak, a liquidus crossing, peak, cooldown and report -- runs in a couple of minutes and the oven is back under the 45 C pre-flight limit in a couple more, against roughly thirty for a reflow profile. It exists to iterate on things that have nothing to do with temperature: render failures, memory, screen transitions, the state machine, the console commands. liquidus_c is set to 45 C purely so the run crosses it and exercises the time-above-liquidus path; it means nothing metallurgical. Melts no solder and reflows nothing.
